title: Run entropy review automatically at execution exhaustion
body:
## Outcome

Route execute-all through one recent entropy review when a changed batch reaches true exhaustion, before refill and the final review handoff, while making concrete incidental observations reliable and preventing recursion or repeated review.

## Acceptance criteria

- After refreshing goals and dependencies, execute invokes recent entropy review only when no safe useful work remains and #381 reports at least one uncovered exact event.
- The review runs before exhausted-queue refill and the final human review handoff, and visibly reports its scope and findings or clean result.
- Execution records a qualifying exact review event immediately after it observes a verified review checkpoint, integrated change, or completed goal; administrative transitions and newly suggested goals do not qualify.
- When ordinary work actually encounters concrete bounded out-of-scope entropy, recording an inbox observation is required rather than optional. Execution still never pauses current implementation to conduct an audit, and in-scope defects/test bugs retain their existing handling.
- Successful review covers only its frozen exact manifest. Interruption, stale heads, provider failure, or drift leaves the work due and produces an actionable continuation rather than false completion.
- A batch is reviewed at most once per exact coverage state. Entropy review never invokes execute recursively, and the existing once-per-session refill cap prevents review-created goals from causing an unbounded review/refill loop.
- Category policy and refill caps control which findings can create goals; review execution itself grants no new write authority.
- The ordinary hot path receives only compact event marking and exhaustion routing. Prompt-budget checks prove the full entropy skill is not loaded for every goal.
- Focused workflow tests cover not-due, due, empty inbox, populated/excluded inbox, no-finding, finding, interruption, drift, human-review exhaustion, refill ordering, and loop prevention.

## Scope and probe

This child owns execute routing, qualifying-event marking, required incidental observation wording, refill/review ordering, focused workflow tests, and execution documentation. It does not own the runtime primitive, manual skill, or broad distribution acceptance.

First probe: simulate a verified goal checkpoint followed by an exhausted queue and assert that an exact event is marked and recent entropy review runs before suggestion/refill and review handoff. Current execution goes directly to suggestion/refill and therefore fails the probe.
